fields.title: Fields
fields.description: The field helpers that describe the data of bricks and collections.

data.source:
Schemas are built with `fields.*`. Each helper returns a [Valibot](https://valibot.dev) schema that validates the value, fills in a default when it's missing, and carries a description that the admin turns into a form input. The set is deliberately small.

Every helper takes a `label`, an optional `help` text shown under the input, and an optional `default`.

| Helper | Stores | Options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fields.text` | a one-line string | `required`, `maxLength`, `placeholder` |
| `fields.textarea` | a multi-line string | `required`, `maxLength`, `placeholder` |
| `fields.number` | a finite number | `min`, `max`, `step` |
| `fields.boolean` | `true` or `false` | |
| `fields.select` | one of a fixed set of values | `options`: value → label; the first is the default |
| `fields.url` | an http(s) URL or a path such as `/about` | `required`, `placeholder` |
| `fields.image` | `{ src, alt, title, asset }`: an uploaded image or a URL | `required` |
| `fields.file` | `{ src, title, asset }`: an uploaded file (video, audio, PDF…) or a URL | `accept` (kinds, default all), `required` |
| `fields.date` | a date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `''` | `required` |
| `fields.list` | an ordered list of items | `of` (the item's field), `min`, `max` |
| `fields.object` | a group of named fields | `fields` |
| `fields.reference` | the **id** of a document in another collection | `collection`, `required` |

## Examples

```ts
import { fields } from '@mortar-kit/core';

const schema = {
  title: fields.text({ label: 'Title', required: true, maxLength: 120 }),
  price: fields.number({ label: 'Price', min: 0, step: 0.01 }),
  align: fields.select({ label: 'Alignment', options: { left: 'Left', center: 'Centre' } }),
  cover: fields.image({ label: 'Cover image' }),
  trailer: fields.file({ label: 'Trailer', accept: ['video'] }),
  published: fields.date({ label: 'Published', required: true, default: '2026-01-01' }),
  category: fields.reference({ label: 'Category', collection: 'categories', required: true }),
  links: fields.list({
    label: 'Links',
    of: fields.object({ label: 'Link', fields: { label: fields.text({ label: 'Label' }), href: fields.url({ label: 'URL' }) } }),
  }),
};
```

## Notes

- **Links are checked.** `url`, `image` and `file` accept http(s) URLs, site paths (`/`, `#`, `?`) and `mailto:` or `tel:` links, and reject other schemes such as `javascript:`, because the values end up in `href` and `src`.
- **Uploads store a key, not a URL.** `asset` holds the uploaded file's key and `src` is filled in when content is read, so render `src` and moving files to another bucket keeps every link. See [Assets](/docs/assets).
- **Dates sort as strings.** `YYYY-MM-DD` is stored as written, so a collection can sort by it.
- **References store ids, not slugs.** Renaming a document keeps every link to it. Deleting a document that others reference is refused, and the admin shows where it is used.
- **Select values** must not look like integers (`'1'`, `'2'`): JavaScript reorders such keys. Use names like `c1`.

Types follow the schema: `InferFields<typeof schema>` is the data's type, and bricks and collections infer it for you.
